title: Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease Late Charges and Returned-Payment Fees
content:
**Late charges and returned payments — Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**

**Late charge — status.** A late charge can be assessed only while the lease status is active or maturity extended.

**Late charge — grace period.** A late charge may be assessed only after the grace period of 10 calendar days (the grace period in every tier) following the payment due date has fully elapsed. The grace period is counted in calendar days starting the day after the payment due date, weekends and holidays included, so the first permissible assessment date is the calendar day after the due date plus the grace period. The due date on the lease record is the anchor.

| Payment due date | Grace period runs | First permissible assessment date | Assessment on the 10th day after the due date |
|---|---|---|---|
| June 5 (hypothetical) | June 6 through June 15 | June 16 | not permitted |

**Late charge — one per due date.** No more than one late charge may be assessed for the same payment due date.

**Late charge — amount.** The late charge is 5 percent of the unpaid portion of that monthly payment — the total monthly payment less the payment amounts applied to that monthly payment, as of the assessment date — rounded to the cent, capped at the lower of the company maximum of $30 and the lease's recorded state maximum late charge. Nothing is assessed when the unpaid portion is below $10.

| Unpaid portion (hypothetical) | 5 percent | Lease's recorded state maximum (hypothetical) | Late charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| $9.50 | — | $25 | none (below $10) |
| $300.00 | $15.00 | $25 | $15.00 |
| $532.11 | $26.61 | $25 | $25.00 |
| $700.00 | $35.00 | $50 | $30.00 |

**Returned payments.** A dishonoured payment is reversed in full against the payment it dishonours. Only one returned-payment fee may be assessed for the same dishonoured payment. The returned-payment fee is the lower of the company returned-payment fee of $25 and the lease's recorded state maximum returned-payment fee, and is assessed only for returns for insufficient funds, a closed account or a stop payment.

| Bank return reason | Returned-payment fee assessed |
|---|---|
| Insufficient funds | yes |
| Account closed | yes |
| Stop payment | yes |
